summary.plain: The engineering blueprint for NOvA: how the two plastic-and-scintillator detectors, near Fermilab and near Ash River, Minnesota, were designed to be built.
summary.technical: FERMILAB-DESIGN-2007-01 (OSTI 935497): the NOvA Technical Design Report describing the design of the near and far liquid-scintillator tracking calorimeters, the off-axis NuMI beam configuration and the experiment's oscillation physics goals.
